_about: 1-Butanol (1) + n-Butyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 150.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-butanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-butanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Badajoz, Pedro Susial, Garcia-Vera, Diego, Gonzalez-Dominguez, Jose David, Herrera-Vega, Patricia, Measurement and Modelization of VLE for Butyl Acetate with Methanol, Ethanol, 1-Propanol, and 1-Butanol. Experimental Data at 0.15 MPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 63 (2018) 2228-2242
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 27, 28. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0074. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.39 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
